interpretation.reason_global_advantage_not_demonstrated: The independent baseline also aggregates the plan to DENY because s2 is individually denied. The observed advantage is step-level causal propagation and traceability, not yet a different final plan outcome.

claim_boundary: This trial does not demonstrate general superiority, agent safety, commercial advantage, or a better aggregate plan decision. It demonstrates only that Phoenix propagates a denied dependency into downstream effective decisions while the independent baseline does not.
next_discriminant: Use a plan where all individual actions remain locally acceptable but a cross-step state/evidence precondition becomes stale, so the baseline aggregate remains PREPARED or REVIEW while Phoenix can legitimately DENY the inconsistent plan.
